skills.description: This skill provides 安昕's Beijing-gaokao comprehensive diagnostic engine — turning a student's raw scores/ranks/subject-selection/goal into a layered diagnosis (academic-status + subject-fit + score-positioning + application-risk + action-steps) with an evidence-chain report. Use it when a parent or agent asks "孩子到底哪科弱、为什么弱", "怎么给孩子定位", "这个志愿方案有没有风险", or "给我一个这学期的提升计划". It is the diagnostic sub-layer of the 安昕升学规划 system, distinct from the generic math-diagnosis skills (which it may delegate the math sub-item to). It encodes the backward-chaining logic (goal → required threshold → gap → steps), the four-dimension weak/strong judgment, the evidence-chain report format, and honesty guardrails.
skills.description_zh: 把孩子的分数、排名、选科、目标，变成一份分层升学诊断报告。诊断五个层面：学业状态（哪科弱、为什么弱）+ 学科适配（适合理科还是文科组合）+ 分数定位（在北京什么水平）+ 志愿风险（滑档风险、专业组排序）+ 行动台阶（这学期怎么提分）。输出证据链报告，遵循诚实护栏、不编造数据。适用于家长问「孩子哪科弱」「怎么给孩子定位」「这个志愿方案有没有风险」「给我一个提升计划」。
skills.name: 安昕升学诊断
